itemdesc-fleshings: Hide scrapings. Can be rendered into fat or left to rot.
hideworking-text:
Immersive Hideworking

Prepare, stretch, scrape, salt, and cure hides on traditional wooden frames.

Tanning racks are required to salt, oil, and scrape hides. Both racks display one hide at a time, secured by strings. The hide changes appearance as it is worked. Hides can still be stored on the ground, but soaked hides cannot be scraped there. Immersive storage options will be coming soon.

Building a Tanning Rack

Small Tanning Rack (2 × 2 × 1 blocks; used for small and medium hides)

Large Tanning Rack (3 × 3 × 1 blocks; used for large and huge hides)

Both rack types may be placed in all four orientations. Place a compatible hide onto an empty rack to begin work.

Salting and Preservation

Mount a raw hide. Hold salt and right-click the mounted hide to salt it.

Salt required: Small 1 · Medium 2 · Large 4 · Huge 8

A salted hide must remain on the rack for 48 in-game hours before it can be removed or oiled. Salting in the crafting grid is disabled. Destroying the rack before finishing will destroy the hide.

Oiling and Pelts

Mount a raw hide, or wait until a salted hide has completed its 48-hour rest.

Before oiling, cut vanilla rendered fat into chunks of rendered fat using a knife or cleaver in the crafting grid. These smaller chunks allow fat to be applied directly to hides stretched on a rack.

Hold the fat chunks and right-click the mounted hide to oil it.

Fat chunks required: Small 1 · Medium 2 · Large 4 · Huge 8

Only the mod's fat chunks can be applied to the rack; vanilla lumps of fat cannot be used directly. Oiling hides in the crafting grid is disabled.

An oiled hide must remain on the rack for 48 in-game hours before it turns into a pelt. Destroying the rack before curing finishes will destroy the hide.

Soaking and Scraping

Soak hides using the normal vanilla leatherworking process. Mount a soaked hide, equip a knife, aim at the hide, and hold right-click to scrape it. The top bar shows the progress. You can stop at any time and resume later. Knife scraping of soaked hides in the crafting grid and on the ground has been disabled.

Scraping can also produce fleshings, depending on hide size and chance. They can be left to rot for fertilizing or cooked into chunks of rendered fat.

Bear Hides and Head Removal

Black, brown, panda, polar, and sun bear pelts retain their species-specific appearance on a rack.

Complete bear pelts include the head. Use a knife to cut the head from a complete bear pelt on the ground or mounted on a rack. Doing this in the crafting grid is disabled.

The remaining headless pelt can still be processed as appropriate.
